environment_contract: These variable names are the proposed application contract; provider SDKs do not automatically consume every name. No integration is implemented.

connections.scope: Owner-controlled repository; CI contents:read. No provider secrets needed for reference checks.
connections.verify: Upload package, pin commit/tag, clone fresh, run reference checks and schema checks.

connections.scope: Separate restricted runtime role and migration owner; separate staging/production databases or branches.
connections.verify: Apply baseline only to fresh disposable staging; test runtime RLS/field projection and restore. Confirm required CREATE ROLE/extension privileges.

connections.scope: OIDC identity only; invitation/membership enforced by portal. No directory write permission by default.
connections.verify: Register exact staging callback; select compatible adapter/mapping for proposed auth tables; test invited login, denied membership, signout and revocation.

connections.scope: Private bucket; object permissions limited to application bucket; server-only keys. Separate staging objects.
connections.verify: Configure explicit allowed origins if browser uploads are used; verify private access, expiry, content validation, quarantine/scan and denied cross-user downloads.

connections.scope: Owner-verified sending domain; least-privileged send credential; separate webhook signing secret.
connections.verify: Implement handler before registering webhook; verify signature against raw body, replay/deduplication, approved test-recipient delivery and suppression. API acceptance is not delivery.

connections.scope: Separate event-ingest and signing credentials per environment; no privileged HR payloads in event metadata.
connections.verify: Implement serve handler and transactional outbox first; sync staging functions, verify signatures, retries, duplicate events and dead-letter recovery.

connections.scope: Import implementation repository after app exists; separate environment values; keep secrets server-only. No VERCEL_TOKEN in application runtime.
connections.verify: Select preview/production environment deliberately; deploy after build; validate HTTPS/domain/callback URLs, redacted logs and rollback.

deferred.decision: Select audited unlinkability implementation or external anonymous survey service. Keep launch disabled until reviewed. No provider selected.
Confirm acceptable evidence/assurance and select provider if required. Typed receipt plan is not a validated signing service.
Select scanner/isolated scanning worker and outage behavior before any upload is released from quarantine.
Select calendar provider, OAuth scopes, event verification and conflict authority only if milestone requires sync.
Select fulfillment vendor and budget only if rewards are in scope.
Select/verify inbound domain and reply aliases before enabling candidate inbound replies.
